gold_set: 161 hand-labelled narrations from 8 real Indian bank & card statements (HDFC, ICICI, SBI, Union, IndusInd, Indian Bank)
note: The gold set was used for error analysis while writing rules, so treat it as a regression benchmark. The synthetic hold-out (unseen names) is the blind ML score.

ml_holdout.description: Synthetic narrations built from person names and business stems never seen in training
